title: New Bill Aims to Guarantee Video Game Ownership
excerpt: A proposed congressional bill would direct the FTC to create regulations ensuring consumers truly own the video games they purchase.
body_html:
A new piece of legislation has been introduced in Congress aimed at changing how video game purchases are handled for consumers. Representative Ritchie Torres of New York introduced the Power To The Players Act.

If the legislation passes, it would require the Federal Trade Commission to establish regulations. These rules would guarantee that buyers receive actual ownership of a video game when they pay for it, rather than just a standard licensing agreement.
